history.title: History of Tanza
history.charteredDesc: Originally known as Santa Cruz de Malabon, Tanza was founded in 1760 and renamed on February 28, 1914.
history.populationDesc: One of Cavite's fastest-growing municipalities with 41 barangays and a growing economy.

founded.title: Founded as Santa Cruz de Malabon
founded.text: The town of Santa Cruz de Malabon is established, becoming one of the earliest settlements in the Cavite coast.

revolution.title: Role in the Philippine Revolution
revolution.text: Tanza plays a significant role in the Philippine Revolution against Spanish colonial rule.

independence.title: Philippine Independence
independence.text: The Philippines declares independence; Tanza forms part of the newly established government.

renamed.title: Renamed to Tanza
renamed.text: The municipality is officially renamed Tanza on February 28, 1914, the name it carries to this day.

growth.title: Urban and Agricultural Growth
growth.text: Tanza experiences significant growth in agriculture and early industrialization, attracting more residents to the Cavite coast.

modernization.title: Modernization and Rapid Urbanization
modernization.text: Infrastructure investments and industrial zone expansions accelerate population growth and economic development.

recognition.title: Awards and Recognition
recognition.text: Tanza receives national recognition for good governance, financial housekeeping, and local competitiveness under the current administration.

footer.mission: A community-built transparency portal for the Municipality of Tanza, Cavite. Not an official government website.
